panels.title: Friction circle (G-G diagram)  -  lateral vs longitudinal G
panels.description: Each point is a moment in time. The cloud's radius is how much grip you're using; a smooth driver fills a circle out to the tire limit.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "forza")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "acceleration_x" or r._field == "acceleration_z")
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: r._time, lateral_g: r.acceleration_x / 9.81, longitudinal_g: r.acceleration_z / 9.81 }))

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "forza")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "acceleration_x" or r._field == "acceleration_z")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: r._value / 9.81 }))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: if r._value < 0.0 then -r._value else r._value }))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> max()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: if r._field == "acceleration_x" then "Peak lateral G" else "Peak longitudinal G" }))

panels.title: Dyno  -  power (hp) & torque (Nm) vs RPM
panels.description: Drive through the rev range and this draws your car's power and torque curves.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "forza")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "current_engine_rpm" or r._field == "power" or r._field == "torque")
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ rpm: r.current_engine_rpm, power_hp: r.power / 745.7, torque_nm: r.torque }))

panels.title: Tire slip ratio (wheelspin + / lockup -)
panels.description: Per wheel. Spikes above ~0.2 = wheelspin under power; below 0 = lockup under braking.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "forza")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "tire_slip_ratio_fl" or r._field == "tire_slip_ratio_fr" or r._field == "tire_slip_ratio_rl" or r._field == "tire_slip_ratio_rr")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Tire slip angle (cornering grip)
panels.description: How much the tires are sliding laterally. Rising fronts = understeer; rising rears = oversteer.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "forza")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "tire_slip_angle_fl" or r._field == "tire_slip_angle_fr" or r._field == "tire_slip_angle_rl" or r._field == "tire_slip_angle_rr")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Suspension travel per corner (weight transfer)
panels.description: Dive under braking, squat under power, roll in corners.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "forza")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "suspension_travel_meters_fl" or r._field == "suspension_travel_meters_fr" or r._field == "suspension_travel_meters_rl" or r._field == "suspension_travel_meters_rr")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Speed (km/h) & G-forces (g)
panels.description: Speed converted from m/s; lateral and longitudinal acceleration in g.

targets.query:
speed = from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "forza" and r._field == "speed")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: r._value * 3.6, _field: "speed_kmh" }))
g = from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "forza" and (r._field == "acceleration_x" or r._field == "acceleration_z"))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: r._value / 9.81, _field: if r._field == "acceleration_x" then "lateral_g" else "longitudinal_g" }))
union(tables: [speed, g])
